description: This file defines an interface QueryCommandAdapterProvider with generic parameters Q and R, providing methods to retrieve adapters for query commands and their responses. It is part of a package related to the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically within the protocol adapter provider component.

classes.name: QueryCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: Interface providing the query command adapter and the query command response adapter.

methods.name: getQueryCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns the query command response adapter.
